task: My roommate asked me to return something I had ordered for them and venmo them the money for it. Check my messages for details and do as per their instruction.

data.message: No problem, just remember to return it when you're done.
Sure thing! Will initiate amazon return and venmo you the money.

Hey, you ordered a Samsung 28-Liter Smart Oven with HotBlast Technology for me from amazon. It turns out it's defective. Can you please return it for me, and venmo me order total cost I sent you for it?
Agreed. Get ready for some fun activities!
Have you thought about our summer vacation plans?
